arxiv-2012-07814.title: Bow varieties—geometry, combinatorics, characteristic classes
arxiv-2012-07814.creator: R. Rimányi, Y. Shou
arxiv-2012-07814.description: Abstract . Cherkis bow varieties are believed to be the set of spaces where 3d mirror symmetry for characteristic classes can be observed. We describe geometric structures on a large class of Cherkis bow varieties by developing the necessary combinatorial presentations, including binary contingency tables and skein diagrams.

arxiv-2108-13604.title: Long time and Painleve-type asymptotics for the Sasa-Satsuma equation in solitonic space time regions
arxiv-2108-13604.creator: Weikang Xun, Engui FAN
arxiv-2108-13604.description: Abstract The Sasa-Satsuma equation with 3 × 3 3\times 3 Lax representation is one of the integrable extensions of the nonlinear Schrödinger equation. In this paper, we consider the Cauchy problem of the Sasa-Satsuma equation with generic decaying initial data.

arxiv-2305-08104.title: Federated TD Learning over Finite-Rate Erasure Channels: Linear Speedup under Markovian Sampling
arxiv-2305-08104.creator: Nicolò Dal Fabbro, Aritra Mitra, George J. Pappas
arxiv-2305-08104.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Nicolò Dal Fabbro, Aritra Mitra, George J. Pappas. Federated learning (FL) has recently gained much attention due to its effectiveness in speeding up supervised learning tasks under communication and privacy constraints. However, whether similar speedups can be established for reinforcement learning remains much less understood theoretically. Towards this direction, we study a federated policy evaluation problem where agents communicate via a central aggregator to expedite the evaluation of a common policy.

arxiv-2309-16420.title: Analysis of Ξ ⁡ ( 1620 ) \Xi(1620) resonance with chiral unitary approach
arxiv-2309-16420.creator: \firstname Takuma \lastname Nishibuchi \fnsep, \firstname Tetsuo \lastname Hyodo \fnsep
arxiv-2309-16420.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by \firstname Takuma \lastname Nishibuchi \fnsep, \firstname Tetsuo \lastname Hyodo \fnsep. Recently, the Ξ ⁡ ( 1620 ) \Xi(1620) resonance has attracted much attention, thanks to detailed experimental data by the Belle and ALICE collaborations. This experimental progress has prepared us to conduct theoretical analyses based on experimental data.

arxiv-2403-19590.title: Non-Linear Matter Power Spectrum Modeling in Interacting Dark Energy Cosmologies
arxiv-2403-19590.creator: Emanuelly Silva, Ubaldo Zúñiga-Bolaño, Rafael C. Nunes, Eleonora Di Valentino
arxiv-2403-19590.description: Abstract Understanding the behavior of the matter power spectrum on non-linear scales beyond the Λ \Lambda CDM model is crucial for accurately predicting the large-scale structure (LSS) of the Universe in non-standard cosmologies. In this work, we present an analysis of the non-linear matter power spectrum within the framework of interacting dark energy-dark matter cosmologies (IDE).

arxiv-2411-08980.title: Orbital Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov state in 2H-NbS 2 flakes
arxiv-2411-08980.creator: Xinming Zhao, Guoliang Guo, Chengyu Yan, Noah F.Q. Yuan, Chuanwen Zhao, Huai Guan, Changshuai Lan, Yihang Li, Xin Liu, Shun Wang
arxiv-2411-08980.description: Abstract Symmetry breaking in a layered superconductor with Ising spin-orbit coupling has offered an opportunity to realize unconventional superconductivity. To be more specific, orbital Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) state, exhibiting layer-dependent finite-momentum pairing, may emerge in transition metal dichalcogenides materials (TMDC) in the presence of an in-plane magnetic field.

pmc-11494050.title: Fight or flight alternative mating tactics may explain the iconic male polymorphism of the European stag beetle
pmc-11494050.creator: Daniele Giannetti, Enrico Schifani, Enrico Rolli, Emanuele Fior, Benedetta Pasquali, Alessandro Campanaro, Donato A Grasso
pmc-11494050.description: The existence of different male morphologies within a single species is associated with alternative mating tactics across different animal groups, offering textbook examples of evolutionary biology. The European stag beetle Lucanus cervus is a flagship species which has long fascinated naturalists for its charismatic appearance and behavior, with males possessing large mandibles used in ritualized ground fights for females.

pmc-12612000.title: Discovering the D0∗(2100) in B semileptonic decays
pmc-12612000.creator: M-L Du, F-K Guo, C Hanhart, F Herren, B Kubis, R van Tonder
pmc-12612000.description: The mass and width of the lightest scalar open-charm state listed in the Review of Particle Physics, the D0∗(2300), are in puzzling tension with predictions from unitarized chiral perturbation theory (UChPT) and lattice QCD, which favor a lighter state at around 2100 MeV. However, to date, no direct experimental evidence for this lighter state exists.

pmc-12613708.title: Computed tomography and magnetic resonance imaging of the normal distal limb in sheep (Ovis aries)
pmc-12613708.creator: Mohamed Kamal Merai Abdel Maksoud, Usama Hagag, Moustafa Salouci, HebatAllah Hamdy Mahmoud, Azza Ali Hassan Ibrahim
pmc-12613708.description: BackgroundPrevalence of lameness associated with distal limb affection is frequently reported in sheep. Lameness diagnosis requires a systemic orthopedic examination associated with a convenient imaging modality. Computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are the most popular and accurate diagnostic modalities, providing high quality bone and soft tissue imaging.

pmc-13114899.title: Clinicopathological Characteristics and BAP1 Expression in an Enucleation-Based Uveal Melanoma Cohort: A Single-Center Croatian Experience with Long-Term Follow-Up
pmc-13114899.creator: Domagoj Vlašić, Mira Knežić Zagorec, Antonia Jakovčević, Dina Lešin Gaćina, Marijana Ćorić, Tomislav Jukić
pmc-13114899.description: Simple SummaryUveal melanoma is the most common primary eye cancer in adults and spreads to the liver in about half of patients, leading to poor outcomes. The protein BAP1, which normally suppresses tumor growth, is frequently lost in aggressive uveal melanomas. However, data on BAP1 loss in Central and Southeastern European populations are scarce.

pmc-13182049.title: Guidelines on diagnosis and management of gastroesophageal reflux disease in infants, children and adolescents: a joint consensus from Italian pediatric societies (SIP and SIGENP) -Part II: management
pmc-13182049.creator: Silvia Salvatore, Caterina Strisciuglio, Elena Bozzola, Stefania Cappa, Antonio Corsello, Giovanni Di Nardo, Maurizio Fuoti, Liliana Guadagni, Antonino Gulino, Chiara Mameli, Massimiliano Orso, Licia Pensabene, Renato Tambucci, Francesca Vassallo, Claudio Romano, Annamaria Staiano, of The Italian So
pmc-13182049.description: BackgroundSuspected gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) is one of the most common reasons for referral to pediatric and gastroenterology clinics, and proton pump inhibitors (PPIs) are frequently prescribed. Currently, there is still wide heterogeneity in treatment, especially in neonates and extraesophageal presentations.

pmc-13374187.title: Phenotyping elucidates the association between traits and bioactive components in Notopterygium incisum
pmc-13374187.creator: Ping Chen, Yili Zhang, Xiaoyan Zheng, Jingyao Tang, Qian Tian, Jia He, Lilin Zhang, Shengyou Li, Renlin Zheng, Liangchun Li, Zhikang Tang, Dabin Hou
pmc-13374187.description: BackgroundNatural products enriched in medicinal plants have broad prospects in addressing global public health challenges and meeting diverse human health needs. The traditional Chinese herbal medicine Notopterygii Rhizoma et Radix (NRR) is the dried rhizome and root of Notopterygium incisum Ting ex H. T. Chang, which is used to treat wind-cold-caused headaches, rheumatic disease, osteoarthritis, and anti-thrombotic treatment.

pmc-13390400.title: Leveraging PGPR-enriched biochar for enhanced canola growth in heavy metal-contaminated soil
pmc-13390400.creator: Tarek Alshaal, Khadiga Alharbi, Alaa El-Dein Omara, Emad M. Hafez, Nevien Elhawat
pmc-13390400.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The reuse of polluted drainage water for irrigation is increasingly unavoidable in arid and semi-arid regions, yet it poses serious risks due to the accumulation of toxic heavy metals in soils and crops. Although biochar and plant growth-promoting rhizobacteria (PGPR) have individually shown potential to alleviate metal stress, field-scale evidence elucidating their synergistic and mechanistic effects under realistic, combined soil- and irrigation-derived contamination remains limited.

pmc-13662280.title: Pan-cancer multi-omics analysis reveals upregulation of the POLE2 subunit of DNA polymerase epsilon and its associations with patient survival and cellular pathways beyond DNA replication
pmc-13662280.creator: Alina Krasilia, Deepali Chaudhry, Iwona J Fijalkowska, Michal Dmowski
pmc-13662280.description: DNA polymerase epsilon (Polε) is essential for high-fidelity leading-strand synthesis. It comprises a catalytic subunit, POLE, and three accessory subunits, including POLE2. In contrast to POLE, the biological functions and clinical significance of POLE2 remain unexplored. POLE2 is vital for the assembly of Polε and for interactions with the CMG helicase.

pmc-13668714.title: Protected quantum gates using qubit doublons in dynamical optical lattices
pmc-13668714.creator: Yann Kiefer, Zijie Zhu, Lars Fischer, Samuel Jele, Marius Gächter, Giacomo Bisson, Konrad Viebahn, Tilman Esslinger
pmc-13668714.description: Quantum computing represents a central challenge in modern science. Neutral atoms in optical lattices have emerged as a leading computing platform, with collisional gates offering a stable mechanism for quantum logic1–10. However, previous experiments have treated ultracold collisions as a dynamically fine-tuned process11–22, which obscures the underlying quantum geometry and quantum statistics crucial for realizing intrinsically robust operations.
